# World History Edu

> > A comprehensive educational resource covering world history from ancient civilizations to modern American politics, with focus on Greek mythology, Chinese philosophy, American Revolution, and notable historical figures.

World History Edu provides in-depth articles on historical events, biographical profiles of influential figures like George Washington and John Adams, explorations of ancient mythologies including Greek gods and Phoenician deities, and detailed examinations of pivotal moments from the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World to the Cuban Missile Crisis.

## Key Topics

- Greek Mythology
- American Revolution
- Ancient Greece
- Chinese Philosophy
- Founding Fathers
- Ancient Egypt
- United States History
- Classical Literature
- Confucianism
- Greek Tragedy
- World War I
- Civil War
- Ancient Civilizations
- Biographical Profiles

## American History & Founding Fathers

- [Famous People of the American Revolution](https://worldhistoryedu.com/famous-figures-of-the-american-revolution): Washington, Franklin, Adams and influential American Revolution figures
- [John Adams: Biography, Achievements & Facts](https://worldhistoryedu.com/john-adams-americas-first-vice-president): John Adams' biography from founding father to second U.S. president
- [William Tecumseh Sherman: Biography, Sherman's March, Civil War, & Achievements](https://worldhistoryedu.com/william-tecumseh-sherman-biography-shermans-march-civil-war-achievements): General Sherman's Civil War campaigns and famous March to the Sea
- [A timeline of the key moments in Lyndon B. Johnson's life](https://worldhistoryedu.com/a-timeline-of-the-key-moments-in-lyndon-b-johnsons-life): LBJ timeline from Texas teacher to 36th U.S. president
- [12 Things You Probably Did Not Know About Kamala Harris, America's First Female Vice President](https://worldhistoryedu.com/facts-about-kamala-harris): 12 facts about Kamala Harris, first female U.S. vice president
- [Victoria Woodhull – Biography, Facts, & Major Accomplishments](https://worldhistoryedu.com/victoria-woodhull-biography-facts-major-accomplishments): Victoria Woodhull: first female U.S. presidential candidate biography

## Greek Mythology & Classical Literature

- [List of Roman Gods and their Greek Equivalents](https://worldhistoryedu.com/list-of-roman-gods-and-their-greek-equivalent): Roman-Greek deity equivalents: Jupiter/Zeus, Neptune/Poseidon comparison
- [10 Most Famous Children of Tethys and Oceanus](https://worldhistoryedu.com/children-of-oceanus-and-tethys): Oceanids and river gods descended from Titans Oceanus and Tethys
- [Phoebe, a first generation Titaness in Greek mythology](https://worldhistoryedu.com/phoebe-first-generation-titaness-in-greek-mythology): Titaness Phoebe's role as moon goddess and Oracle of Delphi
- [Atalanta – Origin Story, Family, Power and Abilities](https://worldhistoryedu.com/atalanta-origin-story-family-power-and-abilities): Atalanta's origin as only female Argonaut warrior and huntress
- [This famous Greek playwright was said to have been killed by a turtle](https://worldhistoryedu.com/this-famous-greek-playwright-was-said-to-have-been-killed-by-a-turtle): Aeschylus' unusual death by turtle and his Greek tragedy legacy
- [Anaxagoras: History, Achievements & Facts](https://worldhistoryedu.com/anaxagoras-history-achievements-facts): Pre-Socratic philosopher Anaxagoras' cosmology and nous theory

## Ancient Civilizations & Empires

- [The 7 Wonders of the Ancient World](https://worldhistoryedu.com/the-seven-wonders-of-the-ancient-world): Great Pyramid, Hanging Gardens and 5 other ancient world wonders
- [Emperor Qin Shi Huang (259 BC – 210 BC), the First Emperor of a unified China](https://worldhistoryedu.com/emperor-qin-shi-huang-the-first-emperor-of-a-unified-china): Qin Shi Huang's unification of China and Qin Dynasty achievements
- [Amenhotep III: History, Reign, Achievements, & Death](https://worldhistoryedu.com/amenhotep-iii-history-reign-achievements-death): Amenhotep III's 18th Dynasty reign and New Kingdom Egypt achievements
- [10 Greatest Chinese Philosophers](https://worldhistoryedu.com/greatest-chinese-philosophers-and-their-achievements): Confucius, Zhu Xi and 8 other influential Chinese philosophers' works
- [Major Ancient Phoenician Deities](https://worldhistoryedu.com/major-ancient-phoenician-deities): Phoenician gods Baal, Astarte and Mediterranean religious pantheon

## Modern World History & Conflicts

- [Critical Facts about the Cuban Missile Crisis](https://worldhistoryedu.com/critical-facts-about-the-cuban-missile-crisis): Cuban Missile Crisis: 13-day U.S.-Soviet nuclear standoff in 1962
- [The True End of World War I: Armistice Day Significance](https://worldhistoryedu.com/the-true-end-of-world-war-i-armistice-day-significance): Armistice Day significance and WWI's November 11, 1918 ending

## Notable Biographies & Achievements

- [Noah Webster: Major Achievements & Facts](https://worldhistoryedu.com/noah-webster-biography-achievements-facts): Noah Webster's lexicography achievements and American Dictionary legacy
